assertions.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('engine/prove/config.json')); assert isinstance(d['defaults']['blocked_commands'], list) and len(d['defaults']['blocked_commands'])>0"
assertions.rationale: config.json must define a non-empty blocked_commands array to enforce the safety blocklist during execute phase

assertions.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('engine/prove/prove-assertions.schema.json')); assert 'task_id' in d['required'] and 'assertions' in d['required'] and d['properties']['assertions']['items']['required'] == ['id','category','command','expect_exit','rationale']"
assertions.rationale: Schema must enforce required fields so that malformed assertion files are rejected before execution

assertions.rationale: Plugin mirrors must stay byte-identical to engine/scripts; divergence means plugin users get stale or broken prove logic
